svg.title: Distinguish sequence similarity from a unique explanation
svg.desc: Two explicitly oriented classroom coding segments ATGGAATTTTAA and ATGGAGTTTTAA differ at corresponding position6,A versus G. A short region is not a whole-genome comparison,and size matches need not reveal this substitution. Additional informative independent markers may improve discrimination,but relatives can share alleles and assay quality matters. Nuclear DNA generally reflects both parental contributions;human mitochondrial DNA mainly maternal inheritance;chloroplast inheritance varies by plant species. A matching sequence does not by itself establish a unique identity,guilt,relationship or route of genetic transfer. Fictional applications must compare evidence quality,alternative explanations,consent,privacy and access without collecting personal family information.

g.text: Distinguish sequence similarity from a unique explanation
A labelled short alignment illustrates why marker choice and sampling scope matter.
Short aligned DNA segments, each written 5′→3′
A T G G A A T T T T A A
A T G G A G T T T T A A
A short match or one band leaves many possible sources; it is not a whole-genome comparison.
Additional informative independent markers can improve discrimination; related samples can share alleles.
Nuclear DNA generally includes both parents; human mitochondrial DNA mainly follows the maternal line.
Chloroplast inheritance varies by plant species. State which genome and region were sampled.
A sequence or band match does not establish identity, guilt, transfer route or a complete family relationship.
Test method quality and competing explanations; keep consent, privacy and access in a fictional decision.
